name: Walter Bäumer
features: fair skin, mid-brown hair swept back, pale grey eyes, square jaw, high cheekbones, medium sturdy build, serious workmanlike expression
bio: Came to cars from motorcycles in the early 1930s and served as a Mercedes reserve driver from 1937 to 1939, sharing tenth at the 1938 Swiss Grand Prix with Hermann Lang and leading the Donington Grand Prix field for a while before an engine fire. He drove the last three laps of the 1940 Mille Miglia to bring the BMW 328 home in front with Huschke von Hanstein, and was killed in a road accident in 1941.
